fullPassage:
Perfectly shaped tomatoes grow under purple lighting. Here in the facility, the intensity and timing of light and the nutrients in the water supply are all controlled. This indoor vertical farming facility is able to produce fresh fruit and vegetables all year round.
Vertical farming refers to producing foods in vertically stacked layers integrated into other structures, usually without the need of soil or natural light. Since the plants are stacked above each other, it reduces the amount of space needed to grow crops.
Another advantage of indoor vertical farming is that maintaining the ideal conditions can reduce the time to harvest. "For traditional farming, if the climate is good, you have five to six harvests a year," says the manager of the facility. "In indoor farming, we're now getting roughly 17 harvests out of that same period."
There is also the benefit of a reduced need for water. Any excess water that a plant cannot absorb will drop down to the plants below. The manager says the farm uses 95% less water than farming in a field. "Every time water moves through the system, it's captured and reused."
However, indoor vertical farming has an Achilles' heel: energy consumption. It has been criticized for the high energy input it requires. "Solar power could help bring down energy costs," the manager says. "Large scale farms will have solar panels on each roof. It might support 10 to 15% of our needs."
This farm wants to fill supply chain gaps rather than replace outside fields. "Much of our fruit and vegetables will still be grown under the sun and in soil, which is why it is super important that we also invest in sustainable field farming," the manager says.

questions.passage: Perfectly shaped tomatoes grow under purple lighting. Here in the facility, the (A)[intensity / weakness] and timing of light and the nutrients in the water supply are all (B)[controlled / neglected]. This indoor vertical farming facility is able to produce fresh fruit and vegetables all year round. Vertical farming refers to producing foods in vertically stacked layers (C)[integrated / separated] into other structures. Since the plants are stacked above each other, it reduces the amount of space needed to grow crops. Another advantage of indoor vertical farming is that maintaining the ideal conditions can reduce the time to harvest.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 빛의 강도(intensity)와 타이밍, 영양분이 모두 통제된다(controlled). 수직으로 쌓인 층이 다른 구조물에 통합된(integrated) 형태.
det.analysis:
✅ ① intensity — controlled — integrated: 원문 일치
❌ ② weakness(약함): intensity의 반의어
❌ ③ neglected(방치된): controlled의 반의어
❌ ④ weakness — neglected: 두 단어 모두 원문과 반대
det.tip: intensity(강도) ↔ weakness(약함). controlled(통제된) ↔ neglected(방치된). integrated(통합된) ↔ separated(분리된)

questions.passage: Another advantage of indoor vertical farming is that (A)[maintaining / abandoning] the ideal conditions can reduce the time to harvest. There is also the benefit of a (B)[reduced / increased] need for water. Any excess water that a plant cannot absorb will drop down to the plants below. However, indoor vertical farming has an Achilles' heel: energy consumption. It has been (C)[criticized / praised] for the high energy input it requires.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 이상적인 조건을 유지하면(maintaining) 수확 시간을 줄일 수 있다. 물 필요량이 줄어든(reduced) 이점이 있다. 높은 에너지 투입량으로 비판받아 왔다(criticized).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ maintaining — reduced — criticized: 원문 일치
❌ ① abandoning(포기하는): maintaining의 반의어
❌ ② increased(증가된): reduced의 반의어
❌ ④ praised(칭찬받은): criticized의 반의어
det.tip: maintaining(유지) ↔ abandoning(포기). reduced(줄어든) ↔ increased(증가된). criticized(비판) ↔ praised(칭찬)

questions.passage: This farm wants to fill supply chain (A)[gaps / connections] rather than replace outside fields. "Much of our fruit and vegetables will still be grown under the sun and in soil, which is why it is super important that we also (B)[invest / withdraw] in (C)[sustainable / temporary] field farming," the manager says.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 공급망의 빈틈(gaps)을 메우고자 한다. 지속 가능한 노지 농업에도 투자(invest)해야 한다. 지속 가능한(sustainable) 농업.
det.analysis:
✅ ② gaps — invest — sustainable: 원문 일치
❌ ① connections(연결): gaps의 반의어
❌ ③ withdraw(철수하다): invest의 반의어
❌ ④ temporary(일시적인): sustainable의 반의어
det.tip: gaps(빈틈) ↔ connections(연결). invest(투자하다) ↔ withdraw(철수하다). sustainable(지속 가능한) ↔ temporary(일시적인)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 harvest가 이 글에서 사용된 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: harvest = (작물을) 수확하다/거두어들이다. 이 문맥에서는 '수확까지의 시간을 줄일 수 있다'는 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 작물을 거두어들이는 것: harvest의 기본 의미이자 문맥 일치
❌ ① 심는 행위: 파종(sowing)의 의미
❌ ③ 가공하는 과정: processing의 의미
❌ ④ 씨앗 보관: storing seeds의 의미
det.tip: harvest: (명사) 수확/수확량, (동사) 수확하다. 'time to harvest' = 수확까지의 시간

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the amount of fuel, energy, or effort that is put into a system or process"

det.korean: 시스템이나 과정에 투입되는 연료, 에너지, 노력의 양 = input(투입량)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ input: 투입량. 원문 'the high energy input it requires' 참조
❌ ① output(산출량): 투입의 반대
❌ ② outcome(결과): 무관
❌ ③ harvest(수확): 무관
det.tip: input(투입) ↔ output(산출). energy input = 에너지 투입량
